newsitem.title: BELGIUM: PetroFina's Sigma may become independent - paper.
newsitem.headline: PetroFina's Sigma may become independent - paper.

text.p: Belgian oil group Petrofina's paint division Sigma may need to become an independent unit, PetroFina Chief Executive Officer Francois Cornelis said in a newspaper interview on Tuesday.

"I must admit that Sigma's activities do not really fit in with PetroFina's other businesses. The ideal scenario would be to make Sigma strong enough so that the company can realise its potential as an independent company," Cornelis told Belgian daily De Standaard.
Sigma's contribution to PetroFina earnings fell to 545 million Belgian francs in the first half of 1996 from 816 million in the same 1995 period.
PetroFina said in July it expected the division's results to improve from the second half of 1996.
